messages.subject: Mentors: please add to GSOC-R'23 wiki!
messages.subject_clean: Mentors: please add to GSOC-R'23 wiki!
messages.body_plain:
Dear mentors, I have submitted the application for R project in Google Summer of Code 2023.
The ideas list this year is https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2023/wiki/table%20of%20proposed%20coding%20projects so please add your project ideas ASAP so you can find a contributor.
Thanks!
Toby
